scenes.title: 965 homes for sale in Jamaica under £100k
scenes.vo: Nine hundred and sixty-five homes for sale in Jamaica are listed under a hundred thousand pounds. That's about one in six.

scenes.desc: Typical asking price of homes under £100k (about $98k US)
scenes.vo: The typical one is about seventy-three thousand pounds, roughly ninety-eight thousand US dollars, and it's usually a three-bed house.

scenes.desc: Of homes under £100k are in St Catherine
scenes.vo: Four in ten of them are in St Catherine. Kingston and Clarendon come next.
A low price is a starting point, not a deal. Check what it rents for before you fall for the price.
